assumptions.auctions: Default 2000-block descending price, zero fees and constant true ZEC price. A par-valuing buyer is an assumed response rule, not modeled bidder competition. Borrower PnL is reported only after full debt repayment, collateral return and zero token balance.
assumptions.funding: Ten-block synthetic allocation schedule; nine attempted 500-token purchases with one-block epochs. Quoted ZEC price stays $100 while true-price marks are $20 or $100. Unsold inventory is not valued as recovered dollars.
assumptions.liquidation: True ZEC price changes at height 2 and stays constant. Reports arrive after 0/2/4 blocks. The target has 25 ZEC and 1000 debt; an independent liquidator has 1000 ZEC and 4000 debt. Unavailable liquidator tokens remain with a passive holder. Closure is height 8. No price-dependent new borrowing or external token trades occur.
assumptions.stale_quotes: True ZEC price differs from an old $100 report. A quorum re-signs that old price at height 6 after a pause. Quote advantages assume each traded token is worth $1; they are not realized profits or claims about impaired-token value.

scope: Deterministic signed Rust vault/reserve cases; no market calibration, stochastic probabilities, native funds or peg guarantee.
